name: Ar tonelico II ~Sekai ni Hibiku Shoujo-tachi no Metafalica~
original_name: アルトネリコ２　世界に響く少女たちの創造詩（メタファリカ）
source:
Taking place in the desolate land of Metafalss, a tiny continent built upon the rim of a tower much like the first game's Ar tonelico, it revolves around two opposed factions: the ruling Grand Bell, which has recently declared war against the Goddess Frelia; and the Sacred Army, who believe that the Goddess enables Metafalss to exist. This ire against the Goddess stems from a failure centuries past at creating Metafalica, a paradise-like land spoken of in legend, which was interrupted by a vicious attack by her defenders. In addition to civil war, Metafalss is ravaged by outbreaks of I.P.D, a Reyvateil-specific disease which causes the victim to execute song magic uncontrollably and do much damage to herself and her surroundings.

Protagonist Croix Bartel, a knight of the Grand Bell, is regularly tasked with stopping the harm done by those afflicted. It is while on a mission to contain one such outbreak that Croix, together with his adopted sister Cocona, is put in quite a different situation. The Holy Maiden Cloche, the Reyvateil who leads the Grand Bell in the war, has come under attack by the Sacred Army. He is soon entrusted with protecting her while they escape. While attempting to hide from the Sacred Army, they encounter Luca, another Reyvateil who has known Croix since childhood.

Croix is soon to discover that neither the Grand Bell nor the Sacred Army are what they seem- and nor are Cloche or Luca. Unable to trust anyone except each other (and sometimes not even that), he and his companions struggle along their own path to thwart those who would manipulate them, discover the truth about the Goddess Frelia, and achieve the seven hundred year old dream of Metafalica.

[From [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VideoGame/ArTonelicoIIMelodyOfMetafalica?from=VideoGame.ArTonelico2]TVTropes[/url]]

Like its prequel, Ar tonelico II features the Dive System, in which you can enter a Reyvateil's mind to help them with their inner doubts in visual novel-style sequences and by doing so unlock more powerful Song Magic. Diving is now more closely tied to the main storyline, and completing more than half of a Reyvateil's cosmosphere will require you to 'commit' to them and their ending.

Other new mechanics include Dualstall, in which the Reyvateils take baths together to increase their power; Bath Talk Topics, which occur during Dualstall and make the various Reyvateils fight more confidently alongside each other; and Infelsphere, a dreamlike realm closely linked to the plot in which the heroines deepen their bond with one another in VN-style sequences.
translation:
故事發生在荒涼的梅塔法爾斯——一片建於高塔邊緣的狹小大陸，與前作的阿爾托內裡可塔十分相似。兩股勢力在這裡彼此對立：統治當地、最近向女神芙蕾麗亞宣戰的大鐘堂，以及相信女神維繫著梅塔法爾斯存在的神聖軍。人們對女神的憤怒源自數百年前的一次失敗：他們曾試圖創造傳說中的樂園梅塔法利卡，卻遭女神守護者猛烈襲擊，計畫就此中斷。除內戰之外，梅塔法爾斯還飽受I.P.D.爆發困擾。這種疾病只會感染蕾瓦泰爾，患者將失控地施展詩魔法，嚴重傷害自己和周圍環境。

主角克羅亞．巴特爾是大鐘堂騎士，經常受命制止患者造成的破壞。一次處理I.P.D.爆發的任務中，他與義妹可可娜陷入了截然不同的局面：在戰爭中領導大鐘堂的蕾瓦泰爾聖女克羅榭遭到神聖軍襲擊，克羅亞很快受託保護她逃離。躲避神聖軍追捕時，他們遇見了另一名蕾瓦泰爾瑠珈，她從小便認識克羅亞。

克羅亞很快發現，無論大鐘堂還是神聖軍，都不像表面上那麼簡單；克羅榭與瑠珈同樣各自隱藏著秘密。眾人除了彼此以外無人可信——有時甚至連同伴都無法信任——只能沿著自己的道路艱難前行，挫敗操縱他們的幕後之人，揭開女神芙蕾麗亞的真相，並實現延續七百年的梅塔法利卡之夢。

[摘自[url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VideoGame/ArTonelicoIIMelodyOfMetafalica?from=VideoGame.ArTonelico2]TVTropes[/url]]

與前作一樣，《魔塔大陸2》設有「潛入」系統。玩家可以進入蕾瓦泰爾的內心，在視覺小說形式的劇情中幫助她們解決心中困惑，並藉此解鎖更強大的詩魔法。潛入系統如今與主線劇情扣得更緊；若要完成一名蕾瓦泰爾超過一半的精神世界，玩家必須對她許下「承諾」，並選擇她的結局。

其他新機制包括：讓蕾瓦泰爾一起沐浴以增強力量的「調合浴」；在調合浴期間發生、讓不同的蕾瓦泰爾在並肩作戰時更有自信的「浴室話題」；以及與劇情緊密相連的夢境領域「心靈世界」，女主角們會在視覺小說形式的劇情中加深彼此羈絆。
